text.tspan: Electricity production from fossil fuels, nuclear and renewables World
Electricity generation from fossil fuels (coal, gas, and oil), nuclear, and renewables (solar, wind, hydropower,
bioenergy, geothermal, wave, and tidal), measured in terawatt-hours.
